posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
I don't know if this has been talked about, but even if it has, I wanna talk about it anyway.

Pretty simple question: Which environment would you say is the most 'thematically fitting' for each hero? I know there's a few easy ones, like Legacy belongs in Megapolis and Wraith belongs in Rook City, but that leaves plenty of other heroes and places to cover!

Here's the two rules I can think of right now for your answers:

1. Each ero has only one 'home'. (Legacy has Megapolis)

2. Each environment can have several different heroes in it. (Rook City is the claimed turf of the Wraith, Mister Fixer and Ex-patriette.)

What are your thoughts?

posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
First of, I'm going to be breaking your first rule right and left.  But many regular people have summer homes, so why can't heros be snowbirds too?

 

Legacy - Freedom Tower and Megaopolis 

Tachyon - Freedom Tower and Wagner Mars Base (She's responsible for getting humans to Mars after all)

Wraith - Freedom Tower and Rook City 

Bunker - Freedom Tower

Absolute Zero - Freedom Tower

Unity - Freedom Tower

Ra - Tomb of Anubis (duh)

Fanatic - The Court of Blood and the Celestial Tribunal (maybe.  We haven't seen much of either yet) (The Court of Blood is a bit of an antagonist to Fanatic, rather than a home, but it's the environment that she has the closest ties to)

Haka - The Final Wasteland (For Eternal Haka.  Regular Haka doesn't have a clear home, but if I had to pick one, I'd go for Insula Primalis)

Tempest - The Ruins of Atlantis

Expatriette - Rook City and Insula Primalis (She has lived in both places)

Mr. Fixer - Rook City and the Temple of Zhu Long

Ardent Adept - The Realm of Discord (maybe.  AA is a tricky one, and doesn't really have a good home)

Nightmist - The Realm of Discord

The Scholar - The Realm of Discord (maybe?  Certainly it's the best fit so far for Scholar of the Infinite.  I feel like Madame Mittermeier's Fantastical Festival of Conundrums & Curiosities might be a good fit for him, but we'll have to see.)

Chrono-Ranger - Silver Gulch and the Final Wasteland

Omnitron-X - Omnitron IV

Setback - Rook City

The Sentinels - The Time Cataclysm

K.N.Y.F.E. - The Block

The Naturalist - Insula Primalis

Parse - Freedom Tower

Captain Cosmic - The Enclave of the Endlings

Sky-Scraper - Dok'Thorath

Guise - Everywhere!

posts.name: The Burning Stickman
posts.cooked:
After playing around a bit in the videogame, Nightmist loves the Realm of Discord. Consider:

Mistbound can keep a helpful Distortion out an extra turn or two -- alternately, it can bind the villain deck and make Time Flies a huge boon for the heroes. Even better, if you have two copies in your hand, you can do both -- give yourself a guaranteed extra round of double plays and draws, and keep the villain in the lurch.

The vast majority of her cards are One Shots, so Ghostly Images is all but guaranteed to let her play something useful -- and even if it doesn't, she can turn that self-damage on someone else.

With her healing, she's got a really good chance of being the hero target with the highest HP, so the Ethereal Bonds will go after her -- meaning she can either neuter the villain target of her choice or spend a round playing utility cards like Enlightenment or Planar banishment without the self-damage and Investigate for free cards. The latter is especially useful if there's something boosting damage, like Legacy or Imbued Frailty.

The same applies to Portal Fiend, which can become a huge attack toward the end of the game.

The one card she really doesn't like is Negative Energy Field, since it usually means that 1 hp of damage hits her before she has a chance to reflect away the self damage of cards like Heedless Lash or Oblivion. But aside from that, she synergizes really well with the environment's cards.
